purpose: Historical source reconciliation and architecture backlog. Design response is not implementation or authority.

requirements.title: Brand and formal positioning
requirements.current: The project uses Porga and Self-Evolving Agent Organization System.
requirements.gap: Preserve the brand and verify release names separately.

requirements.title: Naming, trademarks, and namespaces
requirements.current: Readability, memorability, and extensibility guide naming.
requirements.gap: Verify repository, organization, package, domain, and trademark availability.

requirements.title: Generic platform and domain instances
requirements.current: Generic code is separate from domain rules.
requirements.gap: Validate loadable domain templates and instance isolation.

requirements.title: Goals, verification, accumulation, and bounded autonomy
requirements.current: The charter records the four principles and deterministic controls.
requirements.gap: Add goal-based team formation and cross-task learning.

requirements.title: Generate, Operate, Verify, Evolve
requirements.current: The pilot runs a fixed team, verifies sources, and records proposals.
requirements.gap: Add feedback, candidate experiments, and a verified post-adoption loop.

requirements.title: Five-layer target architecture
requirements.current: Runtime, kernel, organization, and proposal code exist.
requirements.gap: Implement and verify the domain layer and complete the target responsibilities.

requirements.title: Chief and goal-based team planning
requirements.current: The Chief frames a research question for a fixed Research and QA sequence.
requirements.gap: Plan from capability gaps and enforce bounds in the kernel.

requirements.title: Six-step project intake
requirements.current: ProjectSpec records a goal and evidence at this baseline.
requirements.gap: Track the charter, success criteria, constraints, assumptions, capabilities, and plan.

requirements.title: Agent Factory and AgentSpec
requirements.current: The factory instantiates Research and QA with versioned capabilities.
requirements.gap: Add contracts, model and Skill references, evaluation, lifecycle, and scoped registration.

requirements.title: Temporary and long-lived agents
requirements.current: The baseline has no candidate promotion or retirement lifecycle.
requirements.gap: Define and test lifecycle transitions and reuse.

requirements.title: Dependent tasks and scheduling
requirements.current: The executor is serial, with checkpoints and manual recovery.
requirements.gap: Add dependency planning, priority, bounded concurrency, and coordination tests.

requirements.title: Organization topology changes
requirements.current: The baseline cannot reorganize its fixed team.
requirements.gap: Compare splits, merges, replacements, pauses, and retirements for quality, cost, and safety.

requirements.title: Diagnosis and improvement candidates
requirements.current: The gate result selects a fixed proposal template.
requirements.gap: Generate comparable candidates based on observed failures, effort, and costs.

requirements.title: Independent evaluation
requirements.current: Evaluate runs six fixed gate regressions.
requirements.gap: Freeze baselines and holdout cases and compare quality, cost, and regressions.

requirements.title: Adoption and rollback
requirements.current: Approval records a decision; deployment remains not_applied.
requirements.gap: Implement an evaluated change package, separate activation, monitoring, and rollback.

requirements.title: Eight dimensions of improvement
requirements.current: The design covers business understanding, memory, skill, efficiency, coordination, organization, decisions, and innovation.
requirements.gap: Define verifiable measures for each dimension.

requirements.title: Six long-term knowledge types
requirements.current: The pilot stores evidence, artifacts, and decisions.
requirements.gap: Persist and govern Evidence, Fact, Hypothesis, Decision, Skill, and Lesson.

requirements.title: Knowledge provenance and validity
requirements.current: Evidence IDs, text, artifact digests, and decision times are retained.
requirements.gap: Add locators, validity, verification, versions, and expiry review.

requirements.title: Project isolation and promotion
requirements.current: Evidence tools are scoped to the current task.
requirements.gap: Verify project isolation and authorize sanitized cross-project promotion separately.

requirements.title: Business assumptions and direction
requirements.current: No business feedback or pivot process exists at the baseline.
requirements.gap: Tie proposals to observed evidence and leave material decisions with the owner.

requirements.title: Chief and kernel separation
requirements.current: The kernel controls capability checks, budgets, and human decisions.
requirements.gap: Retest those controls as the tool and role catalog grows.

requirements.title: Autonomy levels and escalation
requirements.current: The local pilot uses fixed permissions and human approvals.
requirements.gap: Define and test each level after the owner approves its boundaries.

requirements.title: Continuous event-driven operation
requirements.current: The CLI exits after a run.
requirements.gap: Add bounded durable schedules, workers, monitoring, and recovery.

requirements.title: Queue, deduplication, priority, timeout, and replay
requirements.current: The pilot has request-key reuse, timeouts, persistent state, and explicit recovery.
requirements.gap: Add durable attempts and queues with reconciliation for unknown effects and costs.

requirements.title: Runtime integration and adapters
requirements.current: The pilot uses OpenAI Agents SDK and an offline model.
requirements.gap: Evaluate MCP, other runtimes, and host adapters when needed.

requirements.title: Cross-device state and memory
requirements.current: State is stored in SQLite and local files.
requirements.gap: Design identity, isolation, central storage, and concurrency before sharing state.

requirements.title: Definitions, instances, memory, and connectivity
requirements.current: The pilot separates offline and online modes and runs a bounded serial team.
requirements.gap: Test network, concurrent instance, and cross-device boundaries separately.

requirements.title: Private development and public release
requirements.current: The baseline has local history, ignore rules, and a publication guard.
requirements.gap: Verify each authorized remote and release separately.

requirements.title: Separate source from sensitive project data
requirements.current: Examples are synthetic and local state and credentials are excluded.
requirements.gap: Preserve scoped data policies and keep private material outside release trees.

requirements.title: Six core protocols
requirements.current: ProjectSpec, AgentSpec, TaskSpec, EvolutionProposal, EvaluationGate, and PermissionPolicy have schemas.
requirements.gap: Extend the contracts with versioned intake, lifecycle, experiments, adoption, and promotion.

requirements.title: Deployment architecture
requirements.current: The pilot uses Python, SQLite, local files, and the CLI.
requirements.gap: Evaluate shared infrastructure only when verified requirements justify it.

requirements.title: Outcome, quality, cost, and autonomy measures
requirements.current: The pilot records calls, tokens, estimated cost, verification, and decisions.
requirements.gap: Define business value, human dependence, validated improvement, and supporting metrics.

requirements.title: Capability stages P0 through P4
requirements.current: The local kernel covers part of P0.
requirements.gap: Advance each stage through acceptance evidence.

requirements.title: First research task and improvement experiment
requirements.current: Evidence-bounded research, QA, and proposals run locally.
requirements.gap: Test one diagnosis and candidate against an independent baseline.

requirements.title: Domain templates and reuse
requirements.current: Domain templates remain planned.
requirements.gap: Validate synthetic templates on the shared kernel.

requirements.title: License and public identity
requirements.origin: Owner branding goal and historical proposal
requirements.current: The historical baseline used the local package name porga.
requirements.gap: Review namespace, license, and publication scope for each distribution.

requirements.title: External research and vendor claims
requirements.current: Historical references are retained separately from verified facts.
requirements.gap: Review primary sources before using a claim for engineering or public statements.

requirements.title: Verifiable local delivery
requirements.current: Local source, protocols, docs, tests, and Git history exist.
requirements.gap: Verify outcomes using commands and records and check remote delivery separately.

requirements.title: Bounded human involvement
requirements.origin: Explicit owner goal with bounded scope
requirements.current: Each proposal requires a human decision.
requirements.gap: Evaluate escalation and any proposed low-risk autonomy under explicit owner policy.

requirements.title: Local operations, shared service, and research platform
requirements.current: The baseline delivers a single-user local kernel.
requirements.gap: Expand only when measured value and separate acceptance justify it.
